headline._: PHP warns of two emergency fixes for tomorrow, and the details leak a day early.
headline.engineer: Two critical PHP fixes announced for tomorrow; no versions or patches yet.
headline.journalist: The disclosure leaks: The Hacker News names "PHP2Shell" before any fix exists.

items.text: PHP announces two critical security releases for the next day, on the oss-security list.
The Hacker News publishes "Two unpatched critical PHP RCE flaws", a day before the fix: the coordinated disclosure has broken.
Ars Technica: PHP warns it plans two emergency patches imminently.
